personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK fused with 7 Dark-First Utility neon accents
personality_one_liner: A high-energy, Apple-quality premium game economy that drives instant excitement and dopamine through deep contrast, layered glassmorphism, and neon reward cues.

spacing.rule: Generous Apple-style margins (16-24pt) around the screen edges. Content within cards is tightly grouped (8-12pt) to maintain a solid, substantial feel.

do's: Use heavily on top header summaries and bottom navigation bars.
Use on highlighted premium cards (e.g., VaultPass).
Ensure a translucent tinted base (≥75% opacity) beneath the blur to guarantee text readability in dark mode.
dont's: Do not use on every single game mode card; reserve for premium/featured elements to maintain contrast.
Do not use on body text regions or form fields.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Drive momentum and immediate action to play, showcasing current wealth and global status.

states.empty: Should not be empty, but if offline, show 'Offline Mode' subtle state.
states.error: Glowing red retry button with clear text.

screens.layout: Hero-first layout. Top: translucent header with player wealth (coins/gems). Middle: Huge, glowing 'PLAY' CTA as a central focal point, surrounded by subtle animated neon radial blobs in the background. Bottom edge: Edge-anchored mode picker cards (Classic/Daily) and a global leaderboard preview. Safe area at the bottom for banner ads.

screens.name: Mode Select
screens.purpose: Present game variations with distinct visual identities and rewards.
screens.layout: Vertical scrollable list of cards. Each card uses a dark surfaceSecondary base but features distinct neon border glows (Cyan for Daily, Emerald for Streak). Top-aligned titles with prominent coin/reward icons in the layout.

screens.name: Shop
screens.purpose: An aspirational, premium game store to drive VaultPass subscriptions and coin purchases.
screens.layout: Top: A massive, glass-morphic VaultPass Plus hero card with a subtle magenta to cyan gradient overlay and full-bleed artwork. Middle: Grid of coin packs (2-column layout). Bottom: Booster forge section.

screens.name: Round Results
screens.purpose: Deliver a massive dopamine hit with score reveals and reward count-ups.
screens.layout: Centralized, oversized typography for the score reveal. Sequential animations for coins earned and streak multipliers. Large, bottom-sticky 'PLAY AGAIN' CTA.

vault_hero.alt: Abstract glowing neon blue and magenta background

instructions_to_main_agent: Update src/theme.ts with the exact hex values provided in the color object above.

Implement an animated background in the ScreenShell component using react-native-reanimated. Use 2-3 slow-moving radial glow blobs (using absolute positioning, blurred views, or SVG gradients if performant) with the brand, brandSecondary, and brandTertiary colors.
Ensure all primary ActionButtons use a glowing effect. You can achieve this by adding a shadow with the button's background color (e.g., emerald green or cyan) with a high blur radius and low offset.

For the VaultPass card on the Shop screen, use the 'vault_hero' image as a background with an expo-linear-gradient scrim (top to bottom, transparent to heavily tinted surfaceInverse) to ensure text readability.
Do NOT break the Gameplay screen. It must remain functional as a 60-second coin-popping chain arcade round.
Add micro-animations: press scales on ActionButtons (scale down to 0.95), progress bar energy shimmers using reanimated, and sequential fade/slide-ins on the Round Results screen.
Use Space Grotesk for metrics and numbers to give it a premium tech/gaming feel, and Outfit for body text to maintain Apple-like legibility.
Ensure banner ads at the bottom of the screens are not obstructed by sticky CTAs or safe area insets.
